results.title: /ToUnicode covers every used code
results.description: PDF/UA-1 §7.21.3 requires every rendered code to have a working Unicode mapping. A /ToUnicode CMap that is empty (only a codespace range, no bfchar/bfrange) -- or that maps some codes but not the ones actually used on the page -- silently fails text extraction. This check matches each Tj/TJ code against the font's /ToUnicode coverage.

findings.message: font 'BOXDSW+MathematicalPiLTStd-4' (Type1) renders 1 code(s) not covered by its /ToUnicode CMap (e.g. 0x0061)
findings.hint: Extend the /ToUnicode stream's bfchar/bfrange entries to include every code the content stream renders with this font.
